resources.string: This phone has no web browser. When an app wants to open a sign-in page, Login Relay sends it to your computer, and you sign in there.
Waiting for your computer. Connect the phone to a computer running Login Relay with a USB cable. The page will open on the computer.
The page is open in your computer\'s browser. When you\'re done there, you\'ll come back to the app here.
Reconnect the USB cable to a computer running Login Relay to continue signing in.
Couldn\'t open the USB connection. Unplug the cable and plug it in again.
